config: path :memory:, workers false, projectRule null, log captured, no now (global clock)

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search conversation memory (messages and summaries). Returns ranked hits with ids; use memory_get_full for the whole record.

tag.description: Only conversations carrying this key:value tag

tools.name: memory_browse
tools.description: Browse messages in time order, optionally within one conversation or window.

window.description: today, yesterday, this_week, last_24h, last_7d, last_14d

include_tools.description: Include tool calls and results (default false)

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: Counts for the memory store: conversations, messages, summaries, embeddings and queues.

tools.name: memory_get_full
tools.description: The full record behind a search hit: a message with its tool data, or a summary with what it covers.

tools.name: memory_tags
tools.description: Read and decide session tags: list, pending, counts, add, decide, lookup, taxonomy and its edits.

tools.name: memory_append
tools.description: Append one message to a capture session. Idempotent on event_id.

tools.name: memory_ingest_session
tools.description: Ingest a batch of session messages in order. Re-sending the same batch stores nothing twice.

read_tools.name: memory_search
read_tools.description: Search conversation memory (messages and summaries). Returns ranked hits with ids; use memory_get_full for the whole record.

tag.description: Only conversations carrying this key:value tag

read_tools.name: memory_browse
read_tools.description: Browse messages in time order, optionally within one conversation or window.

window.description: today, yesterday, this_week, last_24h, last_7d, last_14d

include_tools.description: Include tool calls and results (default false)

read_tools.name: memory_stats
read_tools.description: Counts for the memory store: conversations, messages, summaries, embeddings and queues.

read_tools.name: memory_get_full

read_tools.name: memory_tags
